mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day return in lowest FEDFUNDS quartile is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening of consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS has positive coefficient with p<0.05 in 5-day return regression, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals a weakening labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC for UNRATE as predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate indicates a weaker labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE as predictor of 5-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day return in highest UNRATE quartile is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 900.0 thousand units signal a contraction in the housing sector that reduces construction-related corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 900.0, or Rank IC for HOUST as predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicate a delayed monetary policy response to inflation, increasing real interest rate uncertainty and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS has positive coefficient with p<0.05 in 60-day return regression, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03.
